paras: Leptosiaphos pauliani is a species of lizard in the subfamily Eugongylinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Cameroon.
The specific name, pauliani, is in honor of French entomologist Renaud Paulian.
The preferred natural habitat of Leptosiaphos pauliani is forest, at elevations of 1,000–2,300 m (3,300–7,500 ft).
